findings.title: Follow Your Ancestor calls 3 undefined functions (setGoldUnit, clearGoldTrail, drawGoldTrailSegment); every shared ?ancestor= link white-screens the app
findings.evidence: VERIFIED LIVE + STATIC. bundle.pretty.js:101086 `(l(it), setGoldUnit(it), clearGoldTrail());` inside st() (pick handler of the ancestor panel Zk); :101101 `drawGoldTrailSegment(It.x, It.y, $n.x, $n.y)`; :101229 `(l(null), setGoldUnit(null), clearGoldTrail(), z(""))` (Change Regiment button). The acorn scope analyser over all 113,377 lines reports these as the only unresolved app identifiers besides CanvasRenderer (-03). Live on production: picking '102nd New York' logs `ReferenceError: setGoldUnit is not defined at st (index-Cg8FAMXN.js:3421:11652) at ut ... at onClick`. Because l(it) runs first, the journey list opens but the rest of st() is skipped (flyTo at :101103 and `yn.setState({selectedUnitId,pinnedUnitId,currentTick:1})` at :101106) so the map never moves and the unit is never selected. Deep link: the effect at :101018-101021 runs `Xe && (l(Xe), st(Xe))` on mount of Zk; loading /?ancestor=U-20ME and opening the star panel throws inside a passive effect, React 18 unmounts the whole tree: #root.childElementCount 1 -> 0, page shows only 'Ask the Historian | Extra Features'. The 'Copy Shareable Link' button (:101117) generates exactly that URL, so every link the app hands out is a crash link.
findings.root_cause: Leftover calls to a removed gold-trail implementation (consistent with the regex-patching workflow described in RECON_SRC README) with no lint/type gate, no test and no error boundary.
findings.fix: 1) Immediate diff: delete the three references, or implement them properly: store field goldUnitId + a 'gold-trail' Mapbox line source updated with map.getSource('gold-trail').setData(lineString of the unit's keyframes) instead of screen-space canvas segments. 2) Move ?ancestor= parsing out of Zk's mount effect into AO: after oobData and placements are loaded, `const id=new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('ancestor'); if (id && oobData[id]) { openAncestorPanel(); selectAncestor(id); history.replaceState(null,'',location.pathname) }`; reject unknown ids. 3) Replace the unawaited navigator.clipboard.writeText at :101118 (it claims 'Link copied' even when the promise rejects) with the shared share helper from -12. 4) Add ESLint no-undef + no-floating-promises to the build (-43).
findings.acceptance_test: Playwright: open /?ancestor=U-20ME, finish onboarding -> ancestor panel opens by itself with the 20th Maine journey, map flies to Little Round Top, zero console errors, #root non-empty. Pick 5 different regiments -> selectedUnitId set and flyTo fired. CI: a file referencing an undefined identifier fails `eslint`.

findings.title: No error boundary or global handler anywhere: a storage exception, missing WebGL, failed lazy chunk or any effect throw blanks the whole app; no error UX for token/network/WebGL failure
findings.evidence: VERIFIED LIVE + STATIC. grep for componentDidCatch|getDerivedStateFromError|ErrorBoundary|window.onerror|unhandledrejection|addEventListener('error' over the app regions returns nothing. Root render :113365 `Rk(document.getElementById('root')).render(V.jsx(pt.StrictMode,{children:V.jsx(AO,{})}))`. Unguarded throw sites: localStorage.getItem in AO's useState initialiser :112951 and setItem :113068 (the only two unguarded storage sites; helpers v4/e2 at :9327-9341 are correctly try/catch'd); `new z_.Map(...)` inside useEffect at :97237 (desktop), :102981 (mobile) and :110770 (walkthrough) with no capability check and no map.on('error'); React.lazy(import('./BookmarkPanel-C5YT4b5k.js')) and HelpModal at :112469-112470 rendered in <Suspense fallback:null> (:113276-113282) - after a redeploy removes the hashed chunk, a stale tab throws on the first click of Help/Bookmarks and Vite's vite:preloadError is unhandled. Live fault injection on production (headless Chrome): (a) localStorage getter throwing SecurityError -> after 12 s #root has 0 children, body text 'Ask the Historian | Extra Features', 0 canvases; (b) getContext('webgl*') returning null -> 'Error: Failed to initialize WebGL' from new Map in the effect -> identical blank page; (c) api.mapbox.com blocked -> only console errors, chooser/tour still shown, no message that the map cannot load; (d) the ?ancestor= crash (-01). index.html has no boot watchdog: if the 2.28 MB module fails, #boot-splash ('Loading the battlefield...') spins forever. Real triggers: Safari 'Block all cookies', some incognito/enterprise profiles, blocklisted GPUs and iOS WebGL context exhaustion, ad-blockers, captive portals, stale tabs after deploys.
findings.root_cause: No defensive layer between the DOM and React: side effects that can throw run in render/effects unguarded; the app assumes storage, WebGL and the network always work.
findings.fix: src/main: `window.addEventListener('error',e=>report('error',e.error||e.message)); window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection',e=>report('unhandledrejection',e.reason)); window.addEventListener('vite:preloadError',e=>{e.preventDefault(); showUpdateToast()})`. `class Boundary extends React.Component{state={err:null}; static getDerivedStateFromError(err){return{err}} componentDidCatch(err,info){report('react',err,info)} render(){return this.state.err?<Fallback err={this.state.err} onRetry={()=>this.setState({err:null})}/>:this.props.children}}`; wrap <App/> and separately every panel/modal (ancestor, roster, OOB, search, walkthrough, help). safeStorage: probe with setItem/removeItem, fall back to an in-memory Map, expose get/set that never throw; use it at :112951/:113068. Boot capability gate before mounting the map: `function webglOk(){try{const c=document.createElement('canvas');return !!(c.getContext('webgl2')||c.getContext('webgl'))}catch{return false}}`; if false render a real fallback page (what the site is, links to the 20 static pages, browser advice) instead of a blank div. Map wrapper: map.on('error') -> 401/403/network -> visible banner 'Map imagery unavailable - units and timeline still work'. index.html watchdog: `setTimeout(()=>{if(!window.__mounted) swapSplashForRetry()},8000)`; set window.__mounted in an AO effect. Wrap Suspense children in a boundary with a 'Reload to get the latest version' fallback.
findings.acceptance_test: Playwright fault matrix run in CI: (1) localStorage throws, (2) WebGL null, (3) api.mapbox.com blocked, (4) lazy chunk 404, (5) throw inside an effect. In every case the page is non-blank, shows a labelled fallback with Retry, remaining features still work where possible, and one report per error reaches the logging endpoint (-36).
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Reliability (C -> A), Best Practices (no uncaught errors), Fit and finish
findings.correction: Live: throwing localStorage getter -> blank #root and 0 canvases after 12 s; null WebGL -> 'Failed to initialize WebGL' -> same blank page; ancestor deep link -> blank. No boundary or onerror in app regions; lines 112951/113068/113365 exact. Effort M assumes editable source.

findings.title: `CanvasRenderer` is not defined: turning the cannon-sound toggle on kills the animation loop the first time armies touch
findings.evidence: VERIFIED LIVE. bundle.pretty.js:96556-96557 inside lS(): `Pe.size > 0 && N4() && (!CanvasRenderer._lastSoundMs || l - CanvasRenderer._lastSoundMs > 4e3) && (jk(), (CanvasRenderer._lastSoundMs = l))`; CanvasRenderer is declared nowhere (scope analyser). N4() returns oT (:96363), set by U4() (:96366) from the bottom-right speaker button yO (:111768-111775, titles 'Enable cannon sound'/'Mute cannon sound'). The expression short-circuits while sound is off, so it only detonates after a visitor enables sound; then the first frame where a Union and a Confederate unit are within 40 px (X4, :96480-96505) throws inside lS. lS is called from the rAF loop Ed (:96998, :97016) and Ed re-schedules itself AFTER lS (:97017), so the loop dies permanently. Live: enable sound, press Space at 8x -> tick advances to 11 then stays at 11 for 8 s; console `ReferenceError: CanvasRenderer is not defined at lS ... at Ed`; the transport still shows the pause icon. Ed also has no try/catch, so any future draw exception has the same effect.
findings.root_cause: A class-static cache (CanvasRenderer._lastSoundMs) left over from a refactor; rAF loop not exception-safe.
findings.fix: Module-level `let lastSoundMs = 0;` and `(l - lastSoundMs > 4000) && (playCannon(), (lastSoundMs = l))`. Make the frame exception-safe: `function Ed(t){ try{ ...body... }catch(e){ reportError(e) } finally{ if (running) rafId = requestAnimationFrame(Ed) } }` (schedule in finally). Create the AudioContext inside the toggle's click (already true) and call resume() on visibilitychange. Add a unit test that renders a frame with sound on and units in contact.
findings.acceptance_test: Playwright: enable sound, play at 8x from tick 1 to tick 100: tick advances continuously, no console errors; a deliberately injected throw in the draw function is reported once and the loop keeps running.
findings.correction: Live A/B: sound OFF at 8x reaches tick 100 in 6 s with 0 errors; sound ON stalls at tick 100 with ReferenceError CanvasRenderer at lS via Ed. Lines 96556-57 exact.

findings.title: The overlay unit canvas (pointer-events:auto, z-index 10) swallows every mouse, wheel and +/- click: the desktop map cannot be panned or zoomed by the user
findings.evidence: VERIFIED LIVE with a control. bundle.pretty.js:97365-97377 renders `<canvas ref=x onClick=...>` as a sibling ABOVE the Mapbox div, styled by ux.canvas at :97393-97399 `{position:'absolute',inset:0,pointerEvents:'auto',cursor:'crosshair',zIndex:10}`. Mapbox binds its handlers on getCanvasContainer() (bundle :89112, :89474, :89841, :90310), a child of the map div, so events landing on the sibling canvas never reach it. Live desktop 1440x900: elementFromPoint(720,450) = CANVAS z=10 pe=auto; CDP-dispatched drag (720,450 -> 420,330) and wheel -600: the 'Improve this map' hash stayed #/-77.235/39.812/13.5; a real click on the zoom-in control (1398,58) did nothing and elementFromPoint at its centre is the CANVAS (nav control sits under the overlay). CONTROL: setting that canvas to pointer-events:none, the same drag moved the map to #/-77.2153/39.80595/13.5 and the zoom-in click changed zoom 13.5 -> 14.5. Same pattern in the mobile map: overlay `bn` :102993-102995 `pointer-events:auto;z-index:10;touch-action:none`. The June build has the same style (deploy-6a2da5d2... ux.canvas) so this is long-standing; only programmatic flyTo (search, ancestor, minimap, tour) can move the camera.
findings.root_cause: Picking was implemented by putting a click-catching canvas over the map instead of using map events; the overlay was never made transparent to interaction.
findings.fix: Minimal (S-M): set `pointerEvents:'none'` on ux.canvas (:97396) and on the mobile overlay (:102995, also remove touch-action:none); do hit-testing from map events: `map.on('click', e => pickUnit(e.point))`, `map.on('mousemove', throttle(e => hover(e.point)))`; move the Distance tool's `window.__gtbgApp._gbDist` hook (:97370-97374, :112758) to a map.on('click') listener owned by the tool. Strategic (L): stop drawing units on a 2D canvas and render them as Mapbox layers (GeoJSON source + circle/symbol/line layers, feature-state for the casualty flash/glow, queryRenderedFeatures for picking, native symbol collision instead of the O(n^2*8) loop at :96558-96581). unit-rendering-reference.html in the deploy already prototypes the symbol-layer approach.
findings.acceptance_test: Playwright desktop + emulated touch: drag changes the attribution-link hash, wheel zooms, +/- buttons zoom, double-click zooms; clicking a unit still selects it; Distance tool still places two points and draws a line.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Core function (B -> A), Usability; INP (native map handling)
findings.correction: Live: the element at the map centre is the CANVAS (z=10, pointer-events auto), the zoom-in control is covered, and CDP drag plus wheel leave the map hash unchanged. Sequencing note: ship with -07 (redraw on move) and rewire _gbDist, otherwise units float during user pans.

findings.title: Jumping to July 2/3 (day tabs, keys 2/3, scrubber, bookmarks, search) never fetches that day's placements: the map keeps drawing Day-1 positions under a July 3 header
findings.evidence: VERIFIED LIVE + STATIC. Day 2/3 files are requested only by playback crossing tick 200/420: Ed :96991-96992 `it >= 200 && !uA && (aF(), (uA=!0)); it >= 420 && !hA && (lF(), (hA=!0))` (aF/lF :96942-96947 call zp(2)/zp(3)). jumpToDay (:9369-9370), keys '2'/'3' (:112990-112995), the scrubber (:112294-112303), bookmarks and search jumps only call setState({currentTick}). Only the mobile layout preloads all days (zp(1..3) at :103040-103042). Live (desktop, fresh profile, skip intro): click the 'July 3' tab -> header 'July 3, 4:00 AM', 'Tick 451/675', event card 'Day 3 opens with Union XII Corps artillery...', but 0 requests to placements_day2*/day3*/density_day2*/density_day3*, the drawn unit count is identical to tick 1 (47 dots) and the screenshot shows the Day-1 dawn layout (CAV/1 etc.) with a stale 'July 5, 1863' label. The unit panel, minimap and search suffer the same (they read placementsByTick[tick]). Pressing Play afterwards self-heals (first frame triggers aF/lF). This is the real cause of the audit's 'July 3 dawn showed empty fields with units at the edge' (D3). Total shipped placement+density data is only ~380 KB raw (~60 KB brotli, 50 files), so lazy per-day loading buys nothing.
findings.root_cause: Per-day lazy loading was wired to the playback loop only, not to the store's setTick/jumpToDay.
findings.fix: Preferred: build-time script concatenates placements + density into ONE versioned file (data/placements.<hash>.json, or 3 per-day files), preloaded with <link rel=preload as=fetch crossorigin> and fetched once at boot (removes ~50 requests, the double fetches from -10 and the whole Ed prefetch flag logic). Minimum: `ensureDayLoaded(tick)` awaited inside setTick/jumpToDay/scrub/key handlers with a visible 'Loading July 3...' state and prefetch of all days on idle after first paint; make `zp` mark a day loaded only if every file succeeded. Guard consumers: if placementsByTick lacks any keyframe <\= tick show the loading state, not stale data.
findings.acceptance_test: Fresh profile: click July 3 immediately after onboarding -> network shows the data (or already cached), unit set differs from tick 1 and matches the July 3 dataset, no request storm; same for keys 2/3, scrubber drag to 500, bookmark restore and search jump to a Day-3 unit.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Core function, Historical/data consistency; P3 (requests ~76 -> a handful)
findings.correction: Mechanism confirmed live: the July 3 tab gives tick 451 and header 'July 3, 4:00 AM' with 0 requests for day2/day3 placements or density (76 /data/ requests total). Numbers are off: the app loads 47 placement+density files = 348,166 B raw (~43 KB brotli concatenated), not ~50 files / ~380 KB / ~60 KB. The 'Play self-heals' claim is supported by code but was not reproduced live: Space did not start playback because focus was on the day button (-17 double toggle).

findings.title: Mobile layout: tapping a unit throws `Invalid LngLat object: (NaN, NaN)`; tap-to-select never works on touch devices
findings.evidence: VERIFIED LIVE (Chrome touch emulation, 375x812 DPR2). bundle.pretty.js:102998-103005 `bn.addEventListener('touchend', nr => { nr.preventDefault(); ya(nr) }, {passive:false})`; ya (:103076-103108) does `nr = $t.touches?.[0] || $t; Vi = (nr.clientX || nr.pageX) - ai.left; ... bn.unproject([Vi, Xr])`. On touchend the `touches` list is empty (lifted finger is in changedTouches) and a TouchEvent has no clientX/pageX, so both coordinates are NaN and Mapbox v3 unproject throws. preventDefault on touchend also suppresses the synthesized click, so the second click listener (:103008) never runs. Live: tapping a unit at its measured screen position (187,448) logged `Error: Invalid LngLat object: (NaN, NaN) at new Ln ... at AM.unproject ... at wu.coordinateLocation` and no unit card appeared. Related: the touch-action:none overlay blocks Mapbox gestures (same root cause as -04), and ya is a stale closure created on the first render (deps [Se] while the listener is bound once at map load, :102998, when oobData is still {}).
findings.root_cause: Touch handler written against click/touchstart event shapes; no NaN guard; listener bound once with a stale closure.
findings.fix: Use pointer events on the overlay only for hit-testing, or (better) map events: `map.on('click', e => pick(e.point))` works for mouse and touch and needs no overlay input. If a custom listener stays: `const t = e.changedTouches?.[0] ?? e; if(!Number.isFinite(t.clientX)) return;`, drop preventDefault on touchend, wrap unproject in try/catch, read oobData via yn.getState() at call time. Remove touch-action:none so pinch/pan reach Mapbox.
findings.acceptance_test: Emulated touch: tap on a unit opens the unit card with name/commander/strength; pan and pinch move the map; no console error; repeat with the touch-drag that ends on a unit (no accidental selection).
findings.correction: Live (375x812, DPR 2, touch): tapping a unit at CSS (187,448) throws 'Invalid LngLat object: (NaN, NaN)' at unproject.

findings.title: Unit canvas is not redrawn when the camera moves while paused: units float at old screen positions after every flyTo (search, ancestor, minimap, monuments, tour); trails smear
findings.evidence: VERIFIED LIVE. The redraw effects at bundle.pretty.js:97285-97322 depend only on [Se (tick), ze (selected unit), Ee (isPlaying)]; the only map 'move' listener in the app is the minimap's (:99731). Live (paused at tick 1): clicking the minimap flew the map ~3 km away; unit-canvas redraw count during 3 s = 0 and the screenshot shows CAV/1, 56 PA, 2 WI etc. hovering over an unrelated forest/quarry while the minimap rectangle has moved. During playback the rAF loop redraws every frame so the bug only shows when paused. Trails: cA (:96728-96753) paints segments in screen space into canvas `so` (module singleton :96690-96707) and Kx() clears only on day change or tour/skip, so after any camera move old trail pixels stay on screen; K4 (:96708-96715) calls getImageData on every ResizeObserver tick (readback warnings, :97271-97278).
findings.root_cause: Canvas is treated as a static picture of tick state rather than a projection of (state, camera).
findings.fix: Redraw on camera change, coalesced: `const redraw = rafCoalesce(draw); map.on('move', redraw); map.on('zoom', redraw); map.on('resize', redraw); map.on('movestart', clearTrails)`; or adopt the layer-based renderer from -04 so the GPU owns registration. Replace the getImageData/putImageData resize dance with a simple clear (trails are ephemeral) and give the 2D context {willReadFrequently:false}. Delete the dead full-viewport canvas from I4 (:9842-9854, created but never drawn or resized).

findings.correction: Live: minimap click moved the map hash to -77.20163/39.79621 with 0 unit-canvas clearRect calls afterwards, and the screenshot shows CAV/1/1 unmoved. Only map 'move' listener is the minimap's (:99731).

findings.title: Sticky module-level cache `i2` in y1() draws 'ghost' units from other ticks and never resets; the boot sweep contaminates tick 1
findings.evidence: VERIFIED LIVE + DATA. bundle.pretty.js:96265 `const i2 = {}` and y1 (:96266-96305): every unit row of every visited tick is written to i2 (`M.forEach(R => { i2[R.unit_id] = R })`) and the result is `Object.values({...i2, ...M})`; i2 is never cleared (no other reference). The boot intro tO (:101487-101506) sweeps currentTick 1 -> 675 in eO=3500 ms (:101471) and the desktop redraw effect calls y1 for every frame, so i2 fills before the user sees tick 1; seeking backwards later keeps future-only units. Data: placements are sparse keyframes - 1,804 rows, 188 of 675 ticks populated, 478 unit ids, only 71 at tick 1, 407 units first appear later (57 on Day 3), median 2 keyframes per unit, 173 units have exactly one keyframe, median gap between keyframes 17 ticks (p90 138, max 658) and only 93 of 1,209 keyframe pairs are consecutive ticks, so y1's f+1 interpolation (:96287-96303) almost never runs and units teleport between keyframes. Live (skip intro at ~4.7 s, tick 1): screenshot shows 12 MA, 83 NY, 97 NY, 88 PA (first appear tick 48) and U-VI-1-1..3 Sixth Corps (first appear tick 180) drawn on the 6:00 AM July 1 map; raw tick-1 data contains none of them.

findings.title: Data loaders have no res.ok/catch/retry; failures are silent or unhandled, days are marked loaded after partial failure, and files are fetched redundantly (up to ~72 requests on mobile)
findings.evidence: VERIFIED LIVE + STATIC. iF (:96834-96899, 14 OOB files), rF (:96919-96922), oF (:96923-96938) use `fetch(...).then(r=>r.json())` with no ok check and no catch; sF (:96939-96941) `await Promise.all([iF(),rF(),oF(),zp(1)])` is called from an effect (:112962-112964) with no catch -> unhandled rejection. Live: blocking one file (oob/union_oob_brigades.json) -> `TypeError: Failed to fetch at iF ... at sF` uncaught, oobData stays {} (search, unit panels and roster empty) with no message. zp (:96900-96918) swallows every per-file failure with `.catch(()=>({placements:[]}))` and then addPlacementsForDay marks the day loaded (`loadedDays`), so a transient failure permanently drops ticks with no retry and no UI. Redundancy: commander_successions.json is fetched by iF and again by Hk; chronology_day1-3 by pO (:102958-102960) and again by PF; mobile calls zp(1) again although AO's sF already did, plus zp(2), zp(3) -> desktop first load ~38 data requests, mobile up to ~72, and a first visit doubles everything through the SW reload (measured 76 requests / 37 unique in one first-visit session).
findings.root_cause: No shared loading abstraction; each loader hand-rolled, optimistic and uncached.

findings.title: Service worker failure modes: caches 404/500 responses permanently, never caches HTML (offline shell impossible), precache is all-or-nothing, cache grows forever, forced reload on every SW change (first visit loads twice)
findings.evidence: VERIFIED LIVE (cache behaviour, double navigation) + STATIC. sw.js:19 `cache.addAll(PRECACHE_ASSETS)` is atomic - one 404 or network blip fails the install; the list hard-codes hashed names (:6-7 index-Cg8FAMXN.js, index-B4G7Z_2G.css; all seven paths currently exist on live). :41-50 cache-first for /assets/ and :61-70 network-first for /data/ call cache.put(request, clone) with NO res.ok check and no e.waitUntil; live test: fetch('/assets/does-not-exist-abc123.js') -> 404 and caches.match afterwards returns the cached 404; same for /data/nope-xyz.json. Cache-first means a transient 404/500 for a hashed asset or lazy chunk is served forever (until CACHE_NAME bump) - the app cannot recover; for /data/ an error response overwrites the last good copy. :73-75 HTML is network-first but never stored, so offline `caches.match(request)` is undefined and `respondWith(undefined)` throws (static; CDP offline mode does not apply to SW fetches so not live-tested). No navigation preload: every navigation pays SW start-up then a serial fetch. Old hashed bundles (2.28 MB each) are never pruned (activate only deletes other cache NAMES). skipWaiting() (:17) + clients.claim() (:30) + index.html:264-268 `controllerchange -> location.reload()`: live first visit shows two main-frame navigations to / ; reg.update() (index.html:270-272) is not returned/caught so offline update failures are unhandled rejections. Mapbox's own 'mapbox-tiles' cache (45 tiles seen) is separate and unaffected.
findings.root_cause: Hand-written SW without response validation, manifest-driven precache, update UX or lifecycle policy.
findings.fix: Rewrite sw.js (~80 lines, or Workbox): precache manifest injected at build (`self.__PRECACHE__`) installed with `Promise.allSettled(list.map(u=>cache.add(u)))`; runtime caching only when `res.ok && res.status===200 && res.type==='basic'`, wrapped in e.waitUntil; strategies: hashed /assets stale-while-revalidate-free cache-first, /data network-first with cached fallback, navigations network-first with `event.preloadResponse` and an offline fallback page (/offline.html precached) ; ignore non-GET and Range requests; on activate delete every /assets entry not in the manifest; drop skipWaiting-then-reload: keep the new SW waiting and show an 'Update available - Reload' toast (postMessage SKIP_WAITING on click) and remove the controllerchange reload; `reg.update().catch(()=>{})`. Consider not registering the SW at all until after first interaction/idle to protect first-visit LCP.
findings.acceptance_test: Lighthouse redirects audit clean on first visit; unit test the fetch handler: 404/500 never cached, install succeeds when one precache URL 404s; DevTools offline after one visit shows the offline page for navigations and cached app for /; deploying a new build leaves exactly one generation of /assets in Cache Storage; no forced reload mid-session.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Performance (LCP/FCP first visit, redirects audit), Reliability
findings.correction: Live: after 1.5 s caches.match returns the cached 404 for /assets/does-not-exist-abc123.js and /data/nope-xyz.json (an immediate check races the un-awaited put). First visit shows privacy -> / -> / (extra reload). sw.js lines exact.

findings.title: Battlefield AR: iOS compass permission requested after multiple awaits (fails on iOS), GPS watch and camera stream leak, unguarded fetch, DOM rebuilt at sensor rate
findings.evidence: STATIC (ar.html; real-device behaviour not tested). The click handler (ar.html:154-207) does `await loadLocations()` (:156), then `await getUserMedia` (:160, permission prompt), then awaits a geolocation prompt (:170-182), and only then calls `DeviceOrientationEvent.requestPermission()` (:186). iOS 13+ requires that call from within the user-gesture call stack; after two prompts the activation is gone, so it rejects and the page reports 'Compass unavailable' - markers never move on iPhones. `navigator.geolocation.watchPosition` (:172) result is never stored and Exit AR (:203-209) only stops video tracks, so GPS keeps running after exit and every Start adds another watcher; if geolocation fails after the camera was granted the function returns at :180-183 without stopping the stream (camera indicator stays on). loadLocations fetch (:156, :100) is outside try/catch with no res.ok -> silent no-op on failure. The watch error callback (:175) marks 'Location denied' even for timeouts after a successful fix. onOrientation -> renderMarkers (:112-139) clears and rebuilds the overlay with innerHTML on every deviceorientation event (up to 60 Hz) using `${loc.name}` unescaped; heading = 360 - alpha ignores deviceorientationabsolute and screen orientation on Android. Start button is not disabled during the flow (double start).
findings.root_cause: Permission flow written as one linear async function without resource ownership.
findings.fix: Order: call `DeviceOrientationEvent.requestPermission?.()` synchronously first in the click handler (before any await), then getUserMedia, then geolocation. Keep `watchId` and `stream` in module state; Exit and every failure path call `clearWatch(watchId)` and stop tracks; disable the button while starting. Wrap loadLocations in try/catch with a visible error. Render markers via requestAnimationFrame with keyed DOM nodes (create once, update style.left), textContent for labels; prefer `deviceorientationabsolute` on Android, low-pass filter heading, account for screen.orientation.angle; distinguish PERMISSION_DENIED/POSITION_UNAVAILABLE/TIMEOUT messages.
findings.acceptance_test: On a physical iPhone and an Android phone: compass permission prompt appears first and markers rotate with the phone; after Exit the GPS indicator and camera light turn off; denying location stops the camera; markers update smoothly without long tasks.
findings.correction: Static: awaits order, unstored watchPosition (:172), requestPermission after two prompts (:186), Exit only stops video tracks all verified. Minor: terrain fetch is ar.html:114, not :100. Real device untested (as stated).

findings.title: Watch Together: HTML-injection sinks, unvalidated tour import and localStorage, guessable room codes, no disconnect/timeout/WebRTC handling, unguarded startup
findings.evidence: STATIC (watch-together.html). renderStops (:172) `row.innerHTML = ...${s.note || '(no note)'}...` where `note` comes from the input field, from localStorage (:159 `JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(...)||'[]')`, unguarded: private mode or corrupt JSON throws and the rest of the IIFE, including every button handler, never runs) and from an IMPORTED tour file (:326 `stops = data.stops` with only Array.isArray checked) - a shared 'tour.json' containing `` executes on this origin when imported (the export/import feature exists precisely to share files). No type/length validation of tick/note. Remote peer data is applied through goToTick (textContent for the caption, so safe) but tick is unvalidated. Rooms: randomCode (:205-210) uses Math.random over a 24-letter alphabet, 5 chars (~8M codes) on the public 0.peerjs.com broker: anyone can join a host by guessing; host never checks incoming data. `typeof Peer === 'undefined'` (:212, :219) is the only capability check - no window.RTCPeerConnection check, so on unsupported browsers `new Peer()` throws inside the click handler. No peer.on('disconnected') / reconnect (broker drop silently stops new joins), no connection timeout (symmetric NAT leaves 'connecting...' forever). A 'goto' that arrives before map load draws nothing and is never re-applied (map 'load' handler :265-277 only replays stops[0]). Export revokes the blob URL immediately after click (:317), which can cancel the download on Safari. Top of the IIFE has 9 unguarded placement fetches (:112-114) and `mapboxgl.accessToken` assumes the CDN script loaded (no SRI on mapbox-gl.js or peerjs@1.5.4 from jsDelivr).
findings.root_cause: User-supplied and peer-supplied data flows into innerHTML and JSON.parse without a validation layer.
findings.fix: Build DOM with textContent (`note.textContent = s.note`); define `TourSchema` (version, stops[<=100]{tick:int 1..675, note:string<=200}) and validate imports and localStorage reads (try/catch, fallback []); cap sizes. Room codes: 8+ chars from crypto.getRandomValues, host handshake token and max 10 peers; validate message shape {type:'goto',tick:int}. Guard on `window.RTCPeerConnection && typeof Peer!=='undefined'`; add peer.on('disconnected', ()=>peer.reconnect()), a 15 s connect timeout with a clear message, and replay `currentTick` after map load. Delay URL.revokeObjectURL by 1 s. Wrap boot in try/catch. Add SRI (integrity+crossorigin) to CDN scripts or self-host them. Privacy page must disclose PeerJS/STUN/TURN (X5).
findings.acceptance_test: Importing a tour whose note is `` shows literal text and runs nothing; corrupt localStorage and private mode still load the page; a 5-char guess cannot join an 8-char room; kill the broker connection -> UI shows disconnected and recovers; test in Safari for export download.
findings.correction: Code facts all verified, but severity should be MEDIUM: the XSS needs the victim to import an attacker-supplied tour file (self-XSS class), the origin holds no credentials or sessions, and a peer 'goto' only sets a tick. The unguarded localStorage read aborting the IIFE before any handler is bound is the highest-impact defect on this page.

findings.title: Backgrounding the tab during playback makes the simulation leap ahead by hundreds of ticks (no dt clamp, no visibilitychange handling)
findings.evidence: VERIFIED with a simulated hidden-tab gap; STATIC for real browsers. bundle.pretty.js:96977 `const ze = F_ ? c - F_ : 16; F_ = c;` then `Hc += ze; ht = Math.floor(Hc/Pe)` (:96982-96986) with Pe = cF/R = 500/speed ms: after rAF resumes the first delta equals the whole hidden time. Live: playing at 4x (8 ticks/s) reached tick 17; pausing requestAnimationFrame callbacks for 20 s (what browsers do to hidden tabs / locked phones) and resuming moved the tick to 182 within 0.6 s (+165 = 20 s x 8). At 16x, 60 s hidden = end of battle. Vignettes (CF window c..c-2 :98268-98271), event cards (byTick[c]) and toasts (bF :99901) only fire on exact/adjacent ticks so everything in the skipped range is never shown, and the casualty-flash bookkeeping uF (:97033-97044) is computed only between H and the new tick. Other timers have the same issue: immersive.html setInterval 350 ms, camera.html 1000 ms, ground-remembers 90 ms, living-ledger, watch-together tour run in the background and are throttled, never paused.
findings.root_cause: Wall-clock deltas used as simulation time with no upper bound and no visibility policy.
findings.fix: PlaybackClock module: `dt = Math.min(now - last, 100)`; on `visibilitychange` hidden -> pause playback (remember wasPlaying) and resume on visible without a catch-up jump; expose the same clock to sub-pages via a tiny shared script. Add an on-screen hint 'Paused while the tab was hidden'.
findings.acceptance_test: Playwright: play at 8x, emulate visibility hidden for 30 s then visible -> tick delta <= 1 s worth (<= 16 ticks) and playback is paused or resumed from the same point; unit test the clock with a 20 s frame gap.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Core function, Usability, INP outliers (RUM spikes up to 2 min)
findings.correction: No visibilitychange in app code; dt unclamped (:96977); 20 s hidden at 4x is about 160 ticks, matching the +165 measured.

findings.title: Minimap 'tick' is frozen: yn.subscribe(selector, listener) is used on a store without subscribeWithSelector, so the listener never fires
findings.evidence: VERIFIED LIVE + STATIC. bundle.pretty.js:99648-99660 (GF): `yn.subscribe((M)=>M.currentTick, (M)=>{...x(M)...})`. The store is plain vanilla zustand (QE at :9115-9137) whose `subscribe: (Ee) => (x.add(Ee), () => x.delete(Ee))` (:9134) takes ONE listener, so the selector is registered as the listener (called on every change, result ignored) and the real listener is never called; useState(() => getState().currentTick) therefore never updates. WF (:99711-99831) draws `x[z]` and the footer `${(x[z]||[]).length} units - tick ${z}` from this frozen value. Live: after jumping to 'Tick 451/675' the minimap still says '72 units · tick 1'; it only refreshes when the minimap is closed and reopened (remount). Even with a live tick, x[z] is the exact-keyframe list, empty on 72% of ticks (see -08).
findings.root_cause: Selector-subscribe API used without the middleware that provides it.
findings.fix: Replace GF with `const tick = yn(s => s.currentTick)` (React selector hook) or wrap the store creation in subscribeWithSelector; compute minimap dots from the shared `stateAt(tick)` (-08) so it shows all units on the field; label 'N units on field - tick T'.
findings.acceptance_test: Jump to tick 451 and scrub: minimap tick label and dot count update within one frame and match the main canvas unit count.
findings.correction: Store subscribe accepts one listener (:9134); GF passes the selector as the listener, so the real callback never runs.

findings.title: Mapbox add/remove races and swallowed errors: default-on Locations labels never render, Layers checkboxes disagree with layer state, Distance tool fails silently
findings.evidence: VERIFIED LIVE (Locations) + STATIC. GtbgLoc (bundle.pretty.js:112573-112676) reads `yn.getState().mapRef` once inside an effect keyed on [active]; the map is created when AO mounts but setMapRef runs only in the map 'load' callback (:97255), so on first mount mapRef is null, the effect returns at :112578 and never re-runs (dependency did not change) although the toolbar 📍 button is ON by default (`useState(!0)` :112943, rendered at :113268). Live: on first arrival no 'Cemetery Hill / The Angle / Seminary Ridge / Peach Orchard / Culps Hill' labels are drawn; after toggling 📍 off and on they appear (screenshots l0/l1). findings.acceptance_test: Fresh load: location labels visible without toggling; opening Layers shows the true state (farm outlines unchecked) and toggles work after reopen; Distance tool draws two markers and a dashed line on 5 consecutive runs including right after load; no empty catch remains (lint no-empty).

Audit H12 root cause is unproven; do not attribute it to the empty catches without a repro.

findings.title: Monuments are implemented twice and both are flawed: a perpetual rAF+setState loop runs at all times, markers are likely 48 px off, a static DOM overlay ignores pan/zoom, mobile monuments are dead

Measured idle (paused, no interaction, headless): desktop 209 rAF callbacks / 5 s and 206 style recalcs, mobile 301 rAF / 5 s and 301 recalcs, script ~14 ms/s. Positioning: markers use `position:fixed; left:kt.x; top:kt.y` (:100918-100920) with map.project() results, which are relative to the map container that starts 48 px below the viewport top (ux.container inset '48px 0 0 0' :97391), and visibility bounds compare kt.y < 48 (:100901) - a probable 48 px vertical offset (verify visually). index.html:608-713 adds a SECOND monument system (static DOM overlay using a fixed default-view Web-Mercator projection, comment admits it 'doesn't track pan/zoom'), wired by polling for a button titled 'Monuments' (:709-712); after a layout switch the toolbar button is a new node and stays unwired, and the overlay is orphaned; it only lists the 9 monuments in monuments.json while the app has 40 (mA) and the walkthrough 512. renderMarkers (:661) retries every 150 ms forever if the container is zero-size. Implement monuments once as a Mapbox GeoJSON source + symbol layer (icon + text, click popup, feature-state highlight when the unit is on the field) toggled by a store flag: zero React re-renders, correct registration, works on mobile and desktop, keyboard access via a list panel. findings.acceptance_test: Idle Chrome trace: no per-frame React commits while paused; monuments stay pinned to their ground positions across pan/zoom; Monuments toggle works on mobile; one monument implementation in the codebase.

findings.title: Every map/data sub-page has the same fragile skeleton: unguarded top-level async, no res.ok, no map error/WebGL handling, render-before-load races, sequential awaits, no live regions
findings.evidence: STATIC across camera, cinematic-export, compare(partly), ground-remembers, immersive, sandbox, viewshed, watch-together, unit-rendering-reference, regiment, report, find-ancestor, historian, living-ledger, education, documentary. Pattern: `(async function(){ ... await Promise.all(files.map(f=>fetch(f).then(r=>r.json()))) ...})()` with no try/catch (only dashboard.html:246-280, compare.html:99-109 and search.html do it right and only compare checks res.ok): a failed fetch leaves '#loading' visible forever with no message. `mapboxgl.accessToken = ...` runs first, so a blocked CDN script (mapbox-gl v3.24.1 from api.mapbox.com, no SRI) is a ReferenceError before anything renders; `new mapboxgl.Map` throws when WebGL is unavailable; no map.on('error') anywhere. Render-before-load races: immersive.html:192 `map.getSource('imm-units').setData` runs every 350 ms from setInterval (:217) as soon as the user enables sound and presses Play, but the source is added only in map 'load' (:167-177) -> TypeError each tick on slow networks; camera.html:222 `select.addEventListener('change', render)` and the mode buttons call render() (:193 getSource(...).setData) before 'load'; viewshed.html select change before load. camera.html:74-78 awaits placements then OOB sequentially (two round trips); ground-remembers.html:64 creates the map only after all 9 fetches finish (audit S2 'blank ~3 s'); the same 9-file placement load is repeated on 8 pages. Same Mapbox token constant copied into 10 files. Status/error elements (#loading, #error, #export-status, #sync-status, #err-box) have no role=status/alert/aria-live.
findings.root_cause: Copy-paste page template without a shared runtime module.
findings.fix: Create /js/page-runtime.js (ES module, shared, cached): `loadJson`, `loadPlacements()` (one memoised call/file), `createMap(container,opts)` that checks WebGL, sets the token from one place, attaches map.on('error'), returns a Promise resolved on load; `showError(el,msg,retry)`; `announce(msg)` into a global aria-live region. Each page: `try{...}catch(e){showError(...)}`; start map creation and data loading in parallel; guard every getSource with `map.loaded()`/ready promise; run setInterval only after ready and pause on document.hidden.
findings.acceptance_test: Per page Playwright: (1) 404 on one data file -> visible error with Retry, (2) WebGL disabled -> friendly fallback, (3) fast clicks before map load produce no console errors, (4) axe shows status/error regions announced.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Reliability, Accessibility, Performance (map appears ~1-2 s earlier)
findings.correction: immersive.html:192/:217 and camera.html:193/:222 render-before-load confirmed; 9 pages load mapbox-gl 3.24.1 from api.mapbox.com with no integrity attribute.

findings.title: Sandbox: no touch support, stuck drag, log flooding, and a disposition list that misrepresents units
findings.evidence: STATIC (sandbox.html). Units are dragged only via map 'mousedown/mousemove/mouseup' (:158-182); Mapbox emits touch events separately so phones cannot drag units (the page scrolls/pans instead). mouseup is bound to the map (:182): releasing outside the canvas (over the edit panel or outside the window) leaves `dragging` set and the unit follows the cursor on re-entry. Every mousemove while dragging calls renderMap() (setData of all ~200+ features) and logChange() (:174-181), so one drag creates dozens of 'moved' log rows and rebuilds the change-list innerHTML each event. DISPOSITIONS (:79) lists 'Column' (not a dataset value) and omits Charging Line, Mounted Cavalry, Dismounted Cavalry, so for a unit in Pickett's Charge the edit <select> shows 'Line of Battle' (first option) and misstates its state. Panel HTML built with innerHTML from unit id/disposition (:139-147). Starting-point labels 'mid-afternoon (tick 260)' and '~3:00pm (tick 553)' come from a different clock than the app (C4). Boot has no try/catch/WebGL guard (-22).
findings.root_cause: Mouse-only implementation and a hand-typed enum.
findings.fix: Use pointer events (map.on('touchstart/touchmove/touchend') alongside mouse) or a pointer-capture drag on the map canvas with a window-level mouseup/pointerup; coalesce updates with rAF and log a single 'moved from A to B' on release; derive the disposition options from placement_schema.json/shared enum and render `selected` from the unit's real value; textContent for panel content.
findings.acceptance_test: Drag a unit on iOS/Android emulation and with mouse released outside the map: unit stops; change log has one entry per drag; select shows 'Charging Line' for a charging unit.
findings.correction: sandbox.html:79 DISPOSITIONS has 'Column' and omits Charging Line / Mounted / Dismounted Cavalry; mouseup on the map (:182); layer-scoped mouse events only.

findings.title: Compare page: duplicate click/hover handlers accumulate on every style switch; popup throws when strength is missing
findings.evidence: STATIC (compare.html). addUnitsLayer() (:202-224) is re-run on every style.load (:239-243) after setStyle wipes the source; it early-returns only if the source exists, so after a style change it re-adds the source/layer AND registers map.on('click','units-layer'), 'mouseenter', 'mouseleave' again (:213-224) - map-level listeners survive setStyle, so N style switches produce N stacked popups per click and N cursor handlers. The popup HTML (:216) uses `p.strength.toLocaleString()` and unescaped `${p.unit_id}${p.disposition}`; Mapbox drops undefined properties so a row without strength throws in the handler (all 1,804 current rows have strength, so this is latent). approxTimeForTick (:126-134) is the 5:00am variant with unused `ampm`. Two WebGL maps + optional terrain on phones raise memory pressure (context loss is unhandled).
findings.root_cause: Listener registration coupled to layer (re)creation.
findings.fix: Register the three listeners once outside addUnitsLayer (`map.on('click','units-layer',...)` works even when the layer is temporarily absent); use `if (p.strength != null)`; build popup content with DOM nodes or escapeHtml; handle `webglcontextlost` with a visible banner and a reload button.
findings.acceptance_test: Switch style 5 times, click a unit: exactly one popup; missing strength shows '-' not a crash.
findings.correction: addUnitsLayer re-registers click/mouseenter/mouseleave after each setStyle (:213-224); p.strength.toLocaleString() is unguarded.

findings.title: Cinematic Export: missing MediaRecorder detection, stuck 'recording' state on any error, unvalidated ticks, leaking blob URLs
findings.evidence: STATIC (cinematic-export.html). :194-196 calls MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported and `new MediaRecorder(stream,{mimeType})` with no `typeof MediaRecorder` check and no try/catch: Safari/iOS without WebM support gets NotSupportedError thrown from the async click handler and no message. Once recording starts (:198-236) any exception inside frame() (e.g. map.getSource null) means the Promise never resolves: rec badge stays, #record-btn stays disabled forever, recorder keeps running (no try/finally). Inputs: start/end ticks are read with Number() and never clamped or NaN-checked (:167-169), so empty fields record a blank video; `totalFrames` (:206) is dead. `recorder.onstop` is assigned after recorder.stop() (:235-236). Each recording creates a new blob URL (:243) that is never revoked. rAF is paused in hidden tabs, so backgrounding mid-recording freezes frames (the UI only says 'stay on this tab'). preserveDrawingBuffer:true (:129) costs performance for the whole page lifetime.
findings.root_cause: Happy-path-only implementation.
findings.fix: Feature-gate the Record button (`typeof MediaRecorder!=='undefined' && HTMLCanvasElement.prototype.captureStream`), try formats in order video/webm;codecs=vp9, vp8, video/webm, video/mp4 and fall back to a clear message; wrap the recording in try/finally that always stops the recorder, hides the badge and re-enables the button; abort on visibilitychange with a message; clamp/validate ticks (integers 1..675, end > start, max span); set onstop before stop(); revoke the previous URL when re-recording; enable preserveDrawingBuffer only during recording (create a temporary map or toggle via a second canvas).
findings.acceptance_test: Safari and Firefox: clear message or MP4 output; simulate a thrown error mid-recording: UI recovers and button re-enables; empty tick fields show validation errors; memory stable after 5 recordings.
findings.correction: Confirmed: no typeof MediaRecorder check, no try/finally, blob URL never revoked, NaN ticks pass. Corrections: an endTick <= startTick check exists (:188) and a captureStream check exists; assigning onstop after stop() is not a bug (event is queued); preserveDrawingBuffer is :145 not :129.

findings.title: Immersive Mode: sound logic misclassifies 'Line of Battle' as charging, no audio resume/pause, background timers
findings.evidence: STATIC (immersive.html). :203 `chargingCount = placements.filter(p => p.disposition === 'Charging Line' || p.disposition === 'Line of Battle')` - Line of Battle is the most common state, so musket crackle plays whenever >3 units are merely standing in line (:207-208), even at dawn on Day 1. Cannon fire triggers on any Deployed Artillery on the field with no proximity/engagement test. AudioContext is created once on the gate click (:96-108) but never resumed after iOS/Safari suspends it (no statechange/visibilitychange handling); setInterval (:217) keeps running in hidden tabs and audio nodes keep being scheduled; volume changes assign gain.value directly (zipper noise); the drone oscillator is never stopped on Pause. initAudio has no try/catch for browsers without AudioContext. render() before map load throws (-22). hourForTick uses the 5:00am-per-day clock (:144-147) - a third variant.
findings.root_cause: Sound heuristics keyed to formation labels rather than engagement; no lifecycle handling.
findings.fix: Derive intensity from contact (units of opposite sides within N metres, or unit notes flagged as engaged) using the same helper as the main app's X4; remove 'Line of Battle' from the trigger; `audioCtx.resume()` on play and on visibilitychange visible, `suspend()` on hidden; pause the interval when document.hidden; use `gain.setTargetAtTime`; stop/start the drone with Play/Pause; try/catch AudioContext creation with a text fallback.
findings.acceptance_test: No gunfire at tick 1; crackle/cannon correlate with contact frames; audio resumes after tab switch on iOS; timers paused while hidden.
findings.correction: immersive.html:203 counts 'Line of Battle' as charging.

findings.title: Mapbox/OSM attribution is disabled on the mobile map and the walkthrough map (attributionControl:false)
findings.evidence: VERIFIED LIVE + STATIC. bundle.pretty.js:102988 (mobile pO) and :110777 (walkthrough _O) create maps with `attributionControl: !1`. Live mobile layout: `.mapboxgl-ctrl-attrib` count 0, `.mapboxgl-ctrl-logo` count 1, no 'Improve this map' link; the desktop map shows '© Mapbox © OpenStreetMap Improve this map © Maxar'. findings.title: Render architecture hot spots: 26 whole-store subscriptions, un-virtualised 700-row panels (5.5k DOM nodes), O(n^2*8) label collision every frame, 210 full-app renders during the boot sweep
findings.evidence: STATIC + measured DOM counts. 26 components call `yn()` with no selector (lines 9910, 97065, 97233, 97416, 97572, 97665, 97907, 98258, 98596, 98747, 99088, 99423, 99713, 99889, 100324, 100845, 101009, 101478, 101680, 102322, 102661, 102941, 111857, 112213, 112940, 112961), so every currentTick change (2/s at 1x, ~32/s at 16x, per scrub event) re-renders all of them and the whole AO tree (no React.memo). The Order-of-Battle (Xk :102321) and Roster (Jk :102660) panels render every OOB entry (~717 rows x several nodes) and stay subscribed to currentTick while open; measured DOM nodes: 505 map-only vs 5,494 with the roster open. lS label de-collision (:96558-96581) runs 8 iterations over all visible pairs at every frame at every zoom (minZoom is 11): ~160k pair checks per frame at 200 visible units, ~640k at 400, before X4's Union x Confederate contact scan (:96480-96505). The intro tO (:101487-101506) calls yn.setState({currentTick}) on every animation frame for 3.5 s (~210 full-app renders) exactly during the LCP/FCP window; the cursor ring iO (:101823-101853) and touch indicator k4 (:9914-9979) setState on every mousemove/touchmove. The y1 interpolation branch (:96295-96298) does `M.find` inside `map` (O(units x keyframes) per frame). Headless 16x play: 6 s wall = 195 ms script, 26 layouts - acceptable on desktop but this is the INP/TBT budget on phones.
findings.root_cause: Store consumed wholesale; canvas doing work a GPU layer or spatial hash would do.
findings.fix: Selector hooks + shallow equality (`yn(s=>s.showLegend)`); split tick into its own store slice consumed only by timeline, canvas and the few tick-aware panels; React.memo panels; virtualise Roster/OOB (react-window) and throttle their tick input to 2 Hz; replace the boot sweep with a lightweight CSS progress animation (do not drive the real store); label de-collision via a grid hash or Mapbox symbol collision (-04 strategic); build a Map for keyframe lookup; cursor ring and touch indicator via CSS transforms/refs not state.
findings.acceptance_test: React Profiler: no commit for panels that do not show tick during playback; with roster open playback commit time < 4 ms; Lighthouse TBT and RUM INP p75 <= 200 ms on a Moto G-class profile; boot sweep issues < 5 store updates.
findings.correction: 26 no-selector yn() sites at exactly the cited lines; 717 OOB ids match the row count.

findings.title: index.html inline-script layer is brittle: DOM scraping by button text, overlay revealed at 5 s during onboarding, unhandled promise, inline handlers block CSP, no boot watchdog
findings.evidence: STATIC + measured. Scripts: SW registration :255-277; populate :294-353; onboarding banner injector :355-396 (polls document.querySelectorAll('body *') every 200 ms x25, finds a leaf whose text matches /choose your experience/ and inserts a node into React-owned DOM); toolbar labeller :398-440 (matches textContent 'S','F','L','B','?'; deletes #seo-content once >=3 match); reveal :441-519 (regex on ancestor textContent for 'select desktop|skip tour...' on every click, capture phase); collision mover :521-606; monuments overlay :608-713 (-21). CSS `animation: gtbg-force-reveal 10ms linear 5s forwards` (:202) force-shows Extra Features/Ask the Historian at 5 s while the guided tour and layout chooser are still up (JS safety net 10 s, :517) - root cause of the overlay sitting on onboarding (H1/H3). Measured cost is small: reposition() 0.3 ms (map only), 1.8 ms with 5.5k nodes, 6.9 ms at 4x CPU throttle; textContent per click ~0.1 ms - fragility not perf. index.html:270-272 `.then(reg => { reg.update() })` drops the rejection (unhandled when offline). :56-57 `onload="this.onload=null;this.rel='stylesheet'"` and the 7 inline scripts require 'unsafe-inline' (CSP blockers, -35). Until then: change the CSS fallback to 25 s or key it off a class, `.catch(()=>{})` on reg.update(), remove the inline onload by inlining critical CSS or using a normal <link rel=stylesheet>, add `translate=no` + notranslate meta to the map shell, add the 8 s boot watchdog, replace overflow:hidden reliance with a responsive layout that reflows at 320 px.
findings.acceptance_test: Overlay never appears above onboarding; no inline scripts/handlers remain (CSP enforce mode passes); Chrome auto-translate to German does not blank the app; 400% zoom reflows without loss.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Fit and finish, Accessibility, Security (CSP), Reliability
findings.correction: index.html:202 force-reveal at 5 s, :517 10 s fallback, :57 inline onload, overflow hidden + contain strict, no translate=no.

findings.title: Clock/date logic exists in 6 inconsistent copies; the +2-day bug lives in 3 of them; even placement_schema.json contradicts the tick arithmetic
findings.evidence: STATIC (exact sources for C3/C4). Store getTickTime (bundle.pretty.js:9371-9383): Day 1 starts 6:00, Days 2/3 start 4:00, label `July ${P}` (correct date). Day/night overlay M4 (:9856-9860): every day starts 5:00. `_F` header (:97428) `July ${l + 2}, 1863`; JF (:100836-100843) and QF (:100998-101007) both format `July ${f + 2}` (monument tooltip, ancestor timeline) and start at 5:00; index.html/cinematic/compare/immersive/camera/living-ledger each re-implement 5:00-per-day (immersive/camera hourForTick, compare approxTimeForTick, living-ledger timeForTick with DAY_BOUNDS [1,226,451,676]); sandbox starting-point labels use the data clock; vignette/chronology strings carry their own hard-coded times (e.g. V-001 'approximately 7:30am' at tick 12 = 5:55am by the 5:00 formula). data/placement_schema.json metadata: Day 2 '5:00am to 7:50pm', Day 3 '5:00am to 8:05pm' whereas 225 ticks x 5 min = 18h45m (-> 11:45pm) and Day 1 '5:00am to 12:40am' is the only consistent row. Live: header shows 'July 3, 1863' under a 'July 1, 6:00 AM' toolbar clock at tick 1.
findings.root_cause: No single source of truth for tick -> civil time and day boundaries.

findings.title: CSP enforcement blockers in the code and a Report-Only policy that reports nowhere
findings.evidence: STATIC. netlify.toml:19 Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only has no report-uri/report-to, so violations are visible only in devtools - the header cannot fulfil its stated purpose ('confirm this allow-list is complete'). Blockers if enforced without change: 7 inline <script> blocks in index.html plus ~15 sub-page inline scripts and inline event attribute (index.html:56-57 onload), static style="..." attributes across pages (need style-src-attr), iframes to www.nps.gov (tour video :100462, walkthrough NPS links) and https://www.google.com/maps/embed (:110661; allowed) - frame-src lists only www.google.com; RUM beacon host ingesteer.services-prod.nsvcs.net missing from connect-src (X3); Mapbox needs worker-src blob, img-src blob/data, connect-src api/events/*.tiles (present); PeerJS wss://0.peerjs.com present but STUN/TURN traffic is not CSP-governed; CDN scripts (mapbox-gl 3.24.1, peerjs 1.5.4) have no SRI. embed.html is sent with X-Frame-Options DENY and CSP frame-ancestors * (X4).
findings.root_cause: Policy authored before inline-script usage was inventoried.
findings.fix: Phase 1: add `report-to`/`report-uri /.netlify/functions/csp` (or a hosted collector) and run Report-Only for 2 weeks; Phase 2: move inline scripts to files (or hash/nonce them via a Netlify edge function), drop inline onload, use style-src-attr 'unsafe-inline' only if needed; add frame-src www.nps.gov, connect-src ingesteer.services-prod.nsvcs.net; SRI or self-host CDN scripts; Trusted Types report-only. Phase 3: enforce.
findings.acceptance_test: Collector shows zero violations for a week of production traffic; enforced CSP passes the full Playwright suite including tour video, Street View, PeerJS, RUM.
findings.correction: Live header is Report-Only without report-uri/report-to; connect-src lacks the RUM host; frame-src is only www.google.com; nps.gov and Google Maps iframes at :100461 / :110660.

findings.title: Observability pipeline: window.onerror/unhandledrejection/CSP reports -> RUM logging (design)
findings.evidence: STATIC. Today the only telemetry is Netlify RUM (Web Vitals) - there is no error, promise-rejection, CSP or feature-usage reporting; the production errors found here (setGoldUnit, CanvasRenderer, NaN LngLat, first-visit reload) were invisible to the owner. RUM shows Poor INP/CLS/FCP/LCP but cannot say why.

Netlify Function (free tier): validate size, rate-limit per IP hash, append to a log drain or Netlify Blobs, daily digest email; dedupe by fingerprint. Add a 'Copy diagnostics' button in every fallback (build id, WebGL renderer, storage available, SW state, last errors) - the same information diagnostics.html (currently 404'd) used to expose.

findings.correction: Observability design proposal; nothing to test.

findings.title: site-nav.js: back link goes to the previous page (not the map), incomplete esc(), late document.body access, no menu focus management
findings.evidence: STATIC (site-nav.js). wireBackLinks (:211-228) turns every a[href='/'] into history.back() whenever the referrer is same-origin and history.length>1, so from map -> search -> compare the '← GETTYSBURG' brand link returns to search, not the map; the 700 ms fallback (:223) can double-navigate if pagehide is late. esc() (:60) escapes & < > " only (not ') and is applied to static constants, so there is no live XSS today but it is the wrong primitive once nav items come from data. loadIconSprite's idle callback calls document.body.insertBefore (:105) which throws if it fires before <body> exists (script is loaded in <head>). findings.title: NPS Auto Tour: stale timers pause playback unexpectedly; toasts/cards leave uncancelled timers; NPS iframe not in CSP
findings.evidence: STATIC. XF Se() (bundle.pretty.js:100329-100341) schedules `setTimeout(() => yn.setState({isPlaying:false}), (tickWindow*500)/2)` and never clears it, so clicking Next quickly, closing the tour, or pressing Play manually lets an older timer pause playback mid-stop. qF toasts (:99913-99915) and nO cards (:101707-101714) create timers with no cleanup on unmount (harmless in React 18 but they call setState after unmount and prevent deterministic tests); the audit's 'toasts never auto-dismiss' is not supported by this code (4.5 s dismissal) - verify on device (timer throttling?). findings.title: Zero-render hazards: 48 `value && <jsx>` sites where the left side can be numeric 0
findings.evidence: STATIC (scans.js). Examples: casualty_percentage `it && ...` (bundle.pretty.js:98928), `Se.casualty_percentage && ...` (:98065) and inline `Se.casualties_killed && ' · ...'` (:98081-98082), ze.trigger_tick (:98336), x.strength `(x?.strength) && ...` (:102307, :102608), Si.notes, c.video, etc. React renders a literal 0 for numeric zero. Current data has no zero values (0 regiments with casualty_percentage 0 or casualties_killed 0), so no visible bug today, but expanded datasets will hit it.

findings.fix: Use `value != null &&` / `Boolean(value) &&` or ternaries; enable eslint-plugin-react `jsx-no-leaked-render`.
